Spaarne Gasthuis (Haarlem)
Radiology Dept
Date: 10 Jan 2025
Exam: mpMRI prostate

Clinical indication: Rising PSA (5.8 ng/mL), prior biopsy Gleason 3+4.

FINDINGS:
Prostate volume measures 54.0 mL. T2-weighted imaging shows a focal area of hypointensity in the right transition zone, extending towards the mid-apex, measuring approximately 12 mm in greatest dimension. This lesion demonstrates restricted diffusion on DWI with corresponding low ADC values. Dynamic contrast-enhanced sequences show early and intense enhancement of the same area. No extracapsular extension or seminal vesicle invasion is identified. No suspicious lymphadenopathy or distant metastases.

IMPRESSION:
PI-RADS 4 lesion in the right transition zone, mid-apex.
PSA density: 0.11 ng/mL/mL.
Clinical stage: cT1c.
csPCa predicted probability 0.48268548.

previous_notes.author: Dr. N. Kuiper (GP)
previous_notes.text: Patient attended for follow-up of elevated PSA. PSA measured at 3.7 ng/mL. Discussed rising trend and referred for urological assessment and MRI-guided biopsy. Biopsy confirmed Gleason 3+4, ISUP GG2 in the right transition zone. Discussed active surveillance versus treatment options. Patient expressed anxiety regarding procedures and requested time to consider options.

previous_notes.author: Dr. N. Kuiper (GP)
previous_notes.text: Patient attended for routine PSA monitoring. PSA measured at 4.6 ng/mL, showing continued rise. Discussed stability of histological findings on prior biopsy. Referred for urological re-evaluation to discuss management options in light of rising PSA and persistent symptoms.

pathology_report:
Biopsy 1 (22 Jul 2023): Histological examination of the prostate tissue reveals acinar adenocarcinoma. The Gleason score is 3+4, corresponding to ISUP grade group 2. No cribriform or intraductal patterns are identified. The tumour is located in the transition zone, mid-apex right.

Biopsy 2 (17 May 2024): Histological examination of the prostate tissue reveals acinar adenocarcinoma. The Gleason score is 3+4, corresponding to ISUP grade group 2. No cribriform or intraductal patterns are identified. The tumour is located in the transition zone, mid-apex right.

Summary: The histological findings remain stable across both biopsy timepoints, with no change in Gleason score or ISUP grade group.

AI-predicted ISUP grade group (digital pathology): grade group 3.
